type_constraints.description: inferred: dynamicEfMin must be integer type
inferred: dynamicEfMax must be integer type
inferred: flatSearchCutoff must be integer type
inferred: replicationFactor must be integer type
verified: match.class/match.where 文档标记 required；缺失应 422（同端点 class-not-found 已由 PR#11497 修正为 422；match 缺失分支遗留 500 通道——GT issue #12041）
type_constraints.assertion: DELETE /batch/objects: match.class AND match.where present, else 4xx

range_constraints.description: inferred: dynamicEfMin <= dynamicEfMax (paired constraint from go source)
inferred: shard count must be a positive integer (>=1); validate() 无显式校验（实测 0 被运行时拒绝 'physical shards unavailable'，负值被 200 接受——GT issue #11729）

assertions.description: inferred: GET /schema should return all collection definitions
inferred: POST /schema should create a new collection
inferred: POST /objects should create a new data object
inferred: POST /graphql should execute GraphQL query

behavioral_contracts.scenario: Create collection via POST /schema, then retrieve via GET /schema/{className}
behavioral_contracts.expected_behavior: Created collection appears in list and is retrievable by name

behavioral_contracts.scenario: Create object via POST /objects, then retrieve via GET /objects/{className}/{id}
behavioral_contracts.expected_behavior: Created object is retrievable with same properties

behavioral_contracts.scenario: Delete object via DELETE /objects/{className}/{id}, then attempt retrieval
behavioral_contracts.expected_behavior: Deleted object returns 404 on subsequent GET

state_invariants.description: After creating a collection, it should be queryable
state_invariants.assertion: Collection exists in GET /schema response after POST /schema

state_invariants.description: After deleting a collection, it should not exist
state_invariants.assertion: Collection does not appear in GET /schema response after DELETE /schema/{className}

state_invariants.description: After inserting N objects, COUNT should return N
state_invariants.assertion: COUNT query returns N after inserting N objects
